/* selectLoginUserHistoryCount - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM ( SELECT C.USER_ID,
CASE WHEN F.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN G.FLNM_ENCPT WHEN H.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '____' || H.INST_NM WHEN F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN I.FLNM_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS USER_NM_ENCPT,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'WORKER' WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'INSTITUTE' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'YOUTHGUARDIAN' ELSE '' END AS USER_TYPE,
C.MDFCN_DT, C.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, C.ENFSN_NO, C.INST_NO, C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO, C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO, C.USER_PSWD_ENCPT, C.USE_BGNG_YMD, C.USE_END_YMD, C.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN, TO_CHAR(C.JOIN_APLY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JOIN_APLY_DT, C.JOIN_APRV_YN, C.JOIN_APRV_YMD, C.JOIN_AUTZR_ID, C.JOIN_RJCT_CS_CN, C.DEL_CS_CN, C.USE_STPGE_CS_CN, C.RM_CN, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT1, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT2, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT3, C.LGN_ERR_CONT, C.PSWD_LAST_CHG_DT, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAA201 C
LEFT JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ ON G.ENFSN_NO = F.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = G.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 I /* 청소년보호자 */ ON I.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO ) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND (E.USER_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{USER_NM_ENCPT}) OR E.USER_NM_ENCPT = '____' || #{USER_NM})
AND E.USER_TYPE = #{USER_TYPE}
AND E.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/* selectLoginUserHistory - Ji-Seob Lee */
SELECT USER_ID, DEC_B64(USER_NM_ENCPT) AS USER_NM_ENCPT, TO_CHAR(MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, USER_TYPE, ENFSN_NO, INST_NO, YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO, INDV_IDNTFC_NO, USER_PSWD_ENCPT, USE_BGNG_YMD, USE_END_YMD, USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN, USER_CNTN_INTRCP_SE_CD, USER_CNTN_INTRCP_CS_CN, TO_CHAR(JOIN_APLY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JOIN_APLY_DT, JOIN_APRV_YN, JOIN_APRV_YMD, JOIN_AUTZR_ID, JOIN_RJCT_CS_CN, DEL_CS_CN, USE_STPGE_CS_CN, RM_CN, BFE_PSWD_ENCPT1, BFE_PSWD_ENCPT2, BFE_PSWD_ENCPT3, LGN_ERR_CONT, PSWD_LAST_CHG_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM ( SELECT C.USER_ID,
CASE WHEN F.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN G.FLNM_ENCPT WHEN H.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '____' || H.INST_NM WHEN F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN I.FLNM_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS USER_NM_ENCPT,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'WORKER' WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'INSTITUTE' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'YOUTHGUARDIAN' ELSE '' END AS USER_TYPE,
C.MDFCN_DT, C.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, C.ENFSN_NO, C.INST_NO, C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO, C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO, C.USER_PSWD_ENCPT, C.USE_BGNG_YMD, C.USE_END_YMD, C.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN, C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_SE_CD, C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_CS_CN, C.JOIN_APLY_DT, C.JOIN_APRV_YN, C.JOIN_APRV_YMD, C.JOIN_AUTZR_ID, C.JOIN_RJCT_CS_CN, C.DEL_CS_CN, C.USE_STPGE_CS_CN, C.RM_CN, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT1, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT2, C.BFE_PSWD_ENCPT3, C.LGN_ERR_CONT, C.PSWD_LAST_CHG_DT, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAA201 C
LEFT JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ ON G.ENFSN_NO = F.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = G.OGDP_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 I /* 청소년보호자 */ ON I.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO ) E
AND E.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD = #{DATAA_CHG_SE_CD}
AND E.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{USER_ID} || '%'
AND (E.USER_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{USER_NM_ENCPT}) OR E.USER_NM_ENCPT = '____' || #{USER_NM})
AND E.USER_TYPE = #{USER_TYPE}
AND E.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
AND E.MDFCN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.MDFCN_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
ORDER BY E.MDFCN_DT DESC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
